dialogue.initial: Welcome, field ecologist. The forest has fallen silent. Help us restore it.
dialogue.partial: I can see the forest beginning to stir. Your work is bearing fruit.
dialogue.active: The forest awakens! The creatures are returning.
dialogue.restored: The forest lives again. Thank you for your dedication.

dialogue.initial: I record the history of our world's collapse and recovery.
dialogue.partial: The records show this pattern of restoration before.
dialogue.active: History is being written anew through your actions.

dialogue.initial: The ruins hold secrets. Tread carefully.
dialogue.partial: I sense movement in the deeper ruins.
dialogue.active: The ruins are awakening. Proceed with caution.
dialogue.restored: The ruins are safe now. Life has returned.
